difficultyAxis: Two entities, one relation, three stories and five scenarios, with the read side constrained by the parent reference (list the stock held by one warehouse). Still create and read only, but the read is not a plain identifier lookup.
rationale: Ramps the tier 2 story and scenario count while keeping the operation set at create plus read. The third story makes the generator emit a collection-returning read scoped by a foreign key, which tier2-01 does not require, and it declares the empty-collection-vs-not-found distinction.

userStories.intent: register a warehouse with a code, a city and a capacity
userStories.benefit: stock can be located at a known facility

scenarios.given: a unique warehouse code and a positive capacity
scenarios.then: the warehouse is persisted and returned with its generated identifier

scenarios.given: a capacity below the permitted minimum
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to register the warehouse
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid before reaching the service layer

userStories.intent: record a stock item held by a warehouse
userStories.benefit: the on-hand quantity and unit cost are known

scenarios.given: an existing warehouse identifier and a non-negative quantity
scenarios.when: the manager records the stock item
scenarios.then: the stock item is persisted with its warehouse reference intact

scenarios.given: a quantity below the permitted minimum
scenarios.when: the manager attempts to record the stock item
scenarios.then: the request is rejected as invalid

userStories.intent: read the stock items held by one warehouse
userStories.benefit: the facility inventory can be reviewed as a whole

scenarios.given: a warehouse holding no stock items
scenarios.when: the manager reads the stock for that warehouse
scenarios.then: the service returns an empty collection rather than reporting an error
